name: SkipNav
description: Skip-to-main-content link that appears on first tab press. Must be the first focusable element in the document. Required for keyboard accessibility.

targetId.description: The id of the main content element to skip to. Default: 'main-content'.

children.description: Link text. Takes precedence over labels.skipToContent.

labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. SkipNavLabels: { skipToContent: string }. The children prop takes precedence over labels.skipToContent.

do: Place SkipNav as the very first child of <body> or your root layout
Ensure the target element has a matching id attribute
Test by pressing Tab on page load — the link should be the first thing that appears
doNot: Do not hide SkipNav with display:none — it must be focusable
Do not place it inside a navigation or header — it goes before those

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to reveal, Enter to activate and jump to main content
accessibility.notes: Uses the visually-hidden-until-focused technique. Appears only on keyboard focus, skipping repetitive navigation for keyboard and screen reader users.
